args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap (Quarrendon Freight Lines, Superior terminal), from #inc-qfl-sev1
• Start: the dock schedule sync wedged around 6:40 AM Superior time on 4 Nov 2025; Dana raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM. Drivers were backing up at the guard shack.
• Cause: Samir Patel (on-call) found it at about 7:17 AM, a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
• Mitigation: Thea joined a bridge for ~20 min. Samir cleared the stuck jobs and a partial sync landed ~8:15 AM, with some inbound trailers still duplicating.
• Resolved: hotfix deployed and replay script finished; all Superior dock schedules syncing cleanly by 2:38 PM. Thea confirmed from the yard and Dana closed it at 2:44 PM.
Note: times are as posted in the channel; the 6:40 start was Dana's estimate. Postmortem notes aren't in the channel yet. Dana, please edit before it goes to Thea.

I posted the draft recap as a reply in your #north-team thread. I built it from the #inc-qfl-sev1 channel, which you're in.

- **Broke:** The Superior sync wedged around 6:40 AM Superior time on 4 Nov 2025. That start time is your own estimate from the channel. You raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
- **Cause found:** Samir Patel, the on-call engineer, found it at about 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Partial fix:** Samir cleared the stuck jobs and a partial sync landed around 8:15 AM. Some inbound trailers were still duplicating at that point.
- **Resolved:** The hotfix and replay script finished and all Superior dock schedules were syncing cleanly by 2:38 PM. You closed the incident at 2:44 PM after Thea confirmed from the yard.

The postmortem notes aren't in the channel yet, so the draft doesn't include them. Please check it over before it goes to Thea.

Picking up Dana's recap: add that the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener and that Thea was on the bridge for about twenty minutes, then put 30 minutes on the calendar for Dana and me tomorrow at 10:00 to walk through it.
